about_the_game:
When her friend crashes during a routine mission on a distant planet, a lone android uncovers a conspiracy that threatens not just the planet but the entire universe's fate.

• Uncover areas, talk to locals, and destroy enemies in an adventure across an open world.

• Combine weapons and abilities like missiles, freeze blasts, and clawshots to overcome all enemies and obstacles in your path.

• Collect items scattered throughout the world to unlock the mystery of the planet Cyros.

• Unlock different modes that will keep you coming back for more.

When her closest friend disappears during a mission on a distant planet, Esquire Robo, a determined android sets out to uncover the truth. What begins as a simple search quickly spirals into something far more dangerous, revealing a vast conspiracy that extends beyond corporate corruption—one that threatens the very fabric of the planet and possibly the universe itself.

As she pieces together the mystery, she’ll be forced to question everything she knows about her creators, her purpose, and the true nature of the forces at play. With danger closing in and impossible choices ahead, she must decide whether to follow her programming or forge her destiny.

Minimum:

  • Processor: i5 or better recommended
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 TI or Greater
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA High Definition Audio or Better
